loss_diagnosis.confirmed: Symmetric Huber bounds prediction-space influence for large residuals; measured high-residual saturation is descriptive.
loss_diagnosis.hypothesis: A robust average loss with limited stable predictive information can favor common magnitudes; neither Huber nor imbalance alone is proven causal.

recommendation_evidence_scope: Training/validation only; no test-driven configuration changes.
limitations: Correlations do not establish feature importance, causality or impossibility of prediction.
Shared/overlapping context and chronology invalidate IID interpretations.
One training seed and reused validation selection limit robustness claims.
Operational reporting availability, magnitude calibration and completeness remain unknown.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: Validation C underpredicts all 75 high targets; 81.3% of their residuals exceed Huber delta 1.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Test whether increasing large-error influence reduces upper-tail shrinkage.
ranked_next_experiments.tradeoff: May raise overall MAE/low-magnitude overprediction and amplify questionable extreme labels.
ranked_next_experiments.validation_only_experiment: FIRST: fixed C parents, architecture, AdamW, seed and stopping; compare existing Huber delta=1 with delta=2 only. Report overall/high MAE, bias and prediction spread. No Optuna or test access; confirm across seeds before claiming a gain.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: Strongest last-step |Spearman|: train 0.744, validation 0.217; correlations vary across periods.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Determine whether current historical summaries provide stable next-event information before adding complexity.
ranked_next_experiments.tradeoff: New regional/context indicators can overfit or require unavailable reporting information.
ranked_next_experiments.validation_only_experiment: Fit a small train-only regularized linear probe on existing last-step/window-mean features in a future task; compare recent-event baseline on validation, then test one justified causal feature at a time.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: C improves validation high MAE over A by 0.0973, yet high underprediction stays 100%.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Express upper-tail error cost directly instead of assuming sampling alone is sufficient.
ranked_next_experiments.tradeoff: Worse overall calibration/MAE and disproportionate influence of uncertain high ML values.
ranked_next_experiments.validation_only_experiment: After isolating the loss, keep the sampler fixed and compare no added loss weights versus a bounded high-target weight fixed from training only; evaluate the validation tradeoff.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: C averages 3124 unique parents and 1849 repeat draws per 4973-draw epoch.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Retain high-target exposure with less duplicate concentration.
ranked_next_experiments.tradeoff: Capping repeats changes effective target exposure and may reduce tail gains.
ranked_next_experiments.validation_only_experiment: Compare approved weighted draws with a conservative per-parent repeat cap, keeping epoch size fixed; record achieved exposure and validation results without changing loss simultaneously.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: C/D show post-best train improvement while validation worsens; selected best checkpoints already limit this.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Reduce late memorization if it is material.
ranked_next_experiments.tradeoff: May further compress predictions or worsen underfitting; early stopping already helps.
ranked_next_experiments.validation_only_experiment: One fixed higher-dropout setting against current C, same loss/sampling; compare best-epoch validation and prediction spread.

ranked_next_experiments.evidence: Current results show little stable explained validation variance; no evidence identifies BiLSTM structure as the cause.
ranked_next_experiments.expected_benefit: Check whether a simpler sequence model generalizes as well with fewer parameters.
